name: Brimstone lobber
description: a brimstone demon of the Cracked Road: a hunched body of cracked black basalt with molten orange light glowing through every seam, short curved horns of charred stone, small burning ember eyes, a wide jaw with a furnace glow inside, squatting low, ash-grey dusty basalt, long thin arms, holding a glowing lump of brimstone ready to throw

poses.stand: squatting low on its haunches, a glowing lump of brimstone held up in one long arm
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: squats, tossing the glowing lump in its hand, watching

attack.action: winds its long arm back and lobs the glowing brimstone lump forward in a high arc to the right, then picks up another

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
